card.name: Nicknames and dialect spellings in names
card.fires_on: Fires on the opening quote mark or the odd-spelled piece right after a first name, where a nickname in quotes is coming. Also fires on clipped dialect words like an', Capt'n and buggers.

modes.label: Quoted nickname
modes.description: A quote mark or bracket after a first name, just before a nickname or pen name.
modes.example: Zhijian<< “>>James” Chen and colleagues at the University

modes.label: Dialect or slangy spelling
modes.description: Informal or clipped spellings inside quoted speech or casual names.

card.writes: It seems to push toward informal name or dialect continuations and away from casual address words like dude or guys.
card.plain: It lights up where a person's nickname in quotes is about to appear, or where speech is spelled in a folksy way.
